description: This file defines the BuzzLikeOnShareAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing 'likes' on shared posts within the OrangeHRM system. It facilitates listing, adding, and removing likes on shares, with detailed annotations for OpenAPI documentation. The class handles input validation, database transactions, and interaction with related data models and services.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing likes on shared posts within the OrangeHRM system, including listing, creating, and deleting likes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of likes on a specific share/post, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Adds a like to a specific share/post, ensuring the user hasn't already liked it, and updates the like count.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Helper method to populate a BuzzLikeOnShare object with the share ID and employee number.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a user's like from a specific share/post and decreases the like count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validation rules for the GET request to list likes, mainly for shareId and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for the POST request to like a share.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for the DELETE request to unlike a share.
